This script writes the analysis tables to `tables/` as CSV files. The Stata wrote its results to log files.

::: {.Rcode title="Source code"}
The full R script is available at:

-   [`R/tables.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Harris-Health-STR/blob/main/R/tables.R)

This R script file is itself reliant on the following helper files:

-   [`R/setup.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Harris-Health-STR/blob/main/R/setup.R)

The code sections below are imported directly from that script when this page is rendered.
:::

```{r}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
#| cache: false
knitr::read_chunk("../R/tables.R")
source("_stata_links.R")
```

## Write the tables

A named list holds every table, and a loop over its names writes each one. `tables/` is ignored by Git: tables made from real data would need clearing before release, and tables made from synthetic data mean nothing.

```{r}
#| label: write-tables
#| eval: false
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| eval: true
#| output: asis
stata_for("write-tables")
```
